objective_breakdown: Energy density, fast-charge plating, low-temperature retention, and 100/500-cycle SEI are jointly binding; ED versus transport/thermal trade-off expected.
candidate_strategy: Chen2020 baseline followed by architecture, electrolyte-transport, particle-size, and SEI-kinetic variants.
budget_allocation: Baseline plus forced 2-4 candidates per round; 1C, lowT, 4C, 100-cycle and 500-cycle protocols; close when achieved or budget exhausted.
risk_and_fallback: Architecture/transport failures return to Stage 3; SEI/material failures escalate to Stage 2; three strikes trigger assumption questioning.

candidates.name: Chen2020 baseline
candidates.role: deterministic baseline cell; no parameter overrides

llm_reason: Task omits electrode chemistry, so deterministic Chen2020 baseline is required for Stage 3 opening characterization.

detail: Stage 2 skipped because start_stage=3; Chen2020 baseline properties are marked baseline.

candidates.name: Transport-SEI variant
candidates.role: higher electrolyte conductivity/diffusivity and lower SEI kinetic rate; values fixed before run as protocol estimates/parameter overrides

llm_reason: Baseline ED passes and 100-cycle SEI passes, but 500-cycle SEI fails; transport and SEI kinetics are targeted while retaining the same Chen2020 architecture.

note: Baseline ED, 100-cycle SEI and low-T capacity are checked; 500-cycle SEI and plating remain failure risks.｜未检查 criteria: max_energy_ev, max_homo_ev, sei_thickness_nm_end_100, lowT_capacity_retention, sei_thickness_nm_end_500

Variant improves SEI and ED, but fast-charge plating is still diagnosed from negative anode potential if present.｜未检查 criteria: max_energy_ev, max_homo_ev, sei_thickness_nm_end_100, lowT_capacity_retention, sei_thickness_nm_end_500

Mechanically derived low-temperature retention equals low-T capacity divided by same-parameter 25-C capacity; SEI values are direct aging outputs.｜未检查 criteria: max_energy_ev, max_homo_ev, energy_density_wh_kg, plated

recommendation: Recommend the Chen2020 Transport-SEI virtual variant: energy density 405.375 Wh/kg, no plating at 4C/45C, 99.455% -20C retention, 300.359 nm SEI at 100 cycles, and 333.097 nm at 500 cycles. Experimental validation is required before production use.
